scope: New GLPK adaptation attempt for exact archived98-region2018/2h scenario. Separate from successful saved-output Table1 analysis.
unit_basis: Input energy-capacity units100000MW=0.1TW and monetary unit10000EUR/MWh times100000MWh=1billionEUR; compare native monetary objective directly with sum of archived per-location/technology total_system_cost. Confirm source units before accepting.

comparison_rule.solver_termination: optimal required for objective acceptance; feasible/time-limit point may be reported only as incomplete.
comparison_rule.objective_tolerance_basis: Analyst-selected0.1percent comparison threshold, looser than archived solver BarConvTol/OptimalityTol1e-4; not an article-prescribed empirical accuracy claim.
comparison_rule.residual_definition: max violations over active Pyomo constraints, normalized by max(1,abs(body),abs(finite bounds)).
comparison_rule.capacity_comparison: Report per-technology aggregate TW differences; no exact equality required because near-optimal solutions may be degenerate. Capacity disagreement prevents any stronger reproduction claim.

changes: Only solver/interface options changed to GLPK5.0 LP with tmlim600; retain modelinputs/geography/time/scenario/custom author constraints.
